name: Multi-Scale Morphological-Prototype and Boosted-Tree Super-Learner
summary: Each patient's slides are summarised by compositional tile-prototype histograms (Virchow2, H-Optimus-1) and PCA-compressed global embeddings (H-Optimus-1, MUSK, CONCH-Z), integrated with clinical covariates via nested probability stacking. Within each training fold, a regularised logistic meta-learner blends out-of-fold probabilities from a clinical-only anchor, linear and boosted-tree prototype classifiers, and multi-encoder gradient boosting, benchmarked against the simple reference. Paired macro-F1 differences across repeated patient-level cross-validation and site-held-out splits with a 95% bootstrap interval determine whether H&E images improve PAM50 prediction.
preprocessing: Pool all slides and tiles per patient_id (handling 46 multi-slide patients and bag sizes of 6-471 tiles) into one patient bag before splitting; verify disjoint patient_id sets across all outer, inner, and site splits, excluding site and any RNA-derived variables from predictors.

Inside each training fold, apply identical clinical preprocessing to floor_clinical, simple_reference, and multimodal arms: median-impute and z-score age on labelled training patients, and one-hot encode stage, histological_type, er, pr, and her2 with explicit missing/indefinite levels.

Using training-fold labelled patients plus the 259 unlabelled patients (never evaluation-fold patients), L2-normalise embeddings, fit 64-dim tile PCA on Virchow2 and H-Optimus-1 before k-means clustering to compute bag-size-invariant prototype-share histograms summing to 1, and fit concatenated patient-mean PCA across H-Optimus-1, MUSK, and CONCH-Z.

Compute inverse-prevalence balanced sample weights strictly from training-fold PAM50 class counts and log iterative convergence curves (k-means centroid shift, per-iteration boosting deviance, and L-BFGS meta-learner loss) until terminal updates plateau below 1% of total fold loss reduction.

tuning.tie_rule: Measure selection spread across inner folds and 2 seeds; break differences within spread (<0.005 macro-F1) toward smaller n_prototypes/n_pca and stronger meta weight_decay, and adopt over simple_reference only when inner-fold macro-F1 strictly exceeds fold-matched simple_reference (A5).

metrics: Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical) across 5x3 repeated nested CV with 10,000-resample patient-level 95% bootstrap CI
Paired out-of-fold multiclass log-loss difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical)
Paired out-of-fold macro one-vs-rest AUROC difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical)
Per-class out-of-fold recall differences for LumA, LumB, Basal, and minority Her2
Pooled leave-one-site-out paired macro-F1 difference across the 19 collection sites with patient-level 95% bootstrap CI
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference against simple_reference on identical folds and per-fold convergence plateau diagnostics
allowed_conclusions: Entitled solely to conclude 'improves' (95% patient-level bootstrap CI strictly > 0), 'worse' (CI strictly < 0), or 'insufficient evidence' (CI contains 0) for incremental patient-level PAM50 prediction over the six clinical variables in this TCGA-BRCA cohort, contextualised by 19-site sensitivity; does not establish standalone H&E accuracy, causal tumour biology, or external cohort generalisability.

diversity.data: compositional Virchow2/H-Optimus-1 tile-prototype histograms + multi-encoder patient-mean PCA + clinical
diversity.model: non-neural heterogeneous stack of prototype classifiers, gradient-boosted trees, and clinical anchor
diversity.method: multi-scale out-of-fold Super-Learner probability stacking with A5 inner-fold simplicity gating

rationale: Quantising tiles into bag-size-invariant prototype proportions preserves focal LumA/LumB heterogeneity while compressing high-dimensional features and dampening continuous stain shifts (D3, D4, D6). Boosted trees model non-linear interactions with missing HER2 (D2), while clinical-anchored probability stacking down-weights overfitted image branches (D7, D9).
